items.title: NL4Opt Competition: Formulating Optimization Problems Based on Their Natural Language Descriptions
items.usedFor: Official NL4Opt test symbolic annotations, converted deterministically to LP; no model-generated oracle.

items.title: LLMs for Mathematical Modeling: Towards Bridging the Gap between Natural and Mathematical Languages
items.evidence: official abstract, existing pinned MAMO source
items.usedFor: Integer diet tasks and published objective answers; full benchmark not claimed.

items.title: OptMATH: A Scalable Bidirectional Data Synthesis Framework for Optimization Modeling
items.usedFor: New directed tour tasks and inspiration for formula/fact-to-language backtranslation. Our logs are synthetic; full OptMATH training pipeline and rejection sampling are not reproduced.

items.title: LLMOPT: Learning to Define and Solve General Optimization Problems from Scratch
items.usedFor: Typed model interface with known physical constraints, variables and parameterized objective. No instruction tuning or complete LLMOPT reproduction.

items.title: OptiMUS: Scalable Optimization Modeling with (MI)LP Solvers and Large Language Models
items.usedFor: LLM/solver separation and one feedback revision. Our residual-based repair is a local adaptation, not reported OptiMUS accuracy.

items.title: Data-driven Inverse Optimization with Imperfect Information
items.evidence: full text, definitions of suboptimality and bounded-rationality losses
items.usedFor: Empirical suboptimality and epsilon-insensitive loss max(loss-epsilon,0). Anchoring to an LLM prior is our combination. No Wasserstein DRO or theoretical sample-complexity claim.

items.title: A fast algorithm to minimize prediction loss of the optimal solution in inverse optimization problem of MILP
items.evidence: full text v2; title differs from current abstract page
items.usedFor: Budgeted projected subgradient comparison with inverse-square-root step. Our box domain, noise and finite50steps differ from theorem assumptions; no inherited finite-time guarantee.

items.title: The Cutting-Plane Method for Solving Convex Programs
items.usedFor: Constraint generation of the empirical inverse problem with certified forward separation.
